**Recommendation**
Decline, per the rules decision. No review flags were raised [review_flags].

**Why**
The rules engine returned CLASS_PROHIBITED: NAICS 722410 (drinking place, bar/nightclub) is a prohibited class [insured.naics_code]. The business is described as a bar and nightclub with live music, open until 2 a.m. [insured.business_description].

**Account**
- Falcon Ridge Lounge LLC, Houston, TX [insured.named_insured][insured.mailing_address.city][insured.mailing_address.state]
- 24 years in business, 136 employees [insured.years_in_business][insured.employee_count]
- Broker: Atlas & Reed Insurance Services [broker.agency_name]
- Renewal effective 2027-02-01, prior carrier Harborline Indemnity Company [policy.transaction_type][policy.effective_date][policy.prior_carrier]
- Quote needed by 2027-01-16 [policy.quote_needed_by]
- Total TIV 47,705,000 across 8 locations [totals.total_tiv][totals.location_count]
- Flood requested [coverage.flood_requested]

**Locations & COPE**
- All 8 locations are Bar / Nightclub occupancy [locations[1].occupancy][locations[8].occupancy].
- Locations 1, 2 and 3 are unsprinklered [locations[1].sprinklered][locations[2].sprinklered][locations[3].sprinklered]. Locations 4 through 8 are 100% sprinklered [locations[4].sprinkler_pct][locations[8].sprinkler_pct].
- The largest location by TIV is Atlanta, GA at 10,935,000 [locations[7].tiv].

**Loss history**
- Five-year incurred is 31,510 against premium of 610,730 [totals.five_year_incurred][totals.five_year_premium]. That is a loss ratio of about 5.2%.
- Closed vandalism claim, incurred 11,580 [claims[CL2122699].cause][claims[CL2122699].status][claims[CL2122699].incurred].
- Open wind/hail claim, incurred 19,930, with 5,020 reserved [claims[HIC202631617].status][claims[HIC202631617].incurred][claims[HIC202631617].reserve].

**Needs attention**
- Communicate the decline to the broker before the quote deadline [policy.quote_needed_by].
- The decision rests on class alone. Loss experience is not a factor in it [totals.five_year_incurred].
